about_the_game:
The CCA facility is an unfolding nightmare. Its only hope for survival rests with its own former personnel—the Stranger Heroes. Unleash them against the horde in this action rogue-lite, a survivor-like focused on rewarding exploration. With each run, you'll piece together two mysteries: the disaster that created this hellscape, and the forgotten past of the hero you command. Their paranormal powers fire automatically. The threats are endless. You must SURVIVE, push deeper, and help them become the myth they were meant to be.

Deep within the monolithic walls of the CCA (Central Control Agency), a catastrophic containment breach has plunged the facility into chaos. The very systems meant to control anomalies seem to be compromised, twisting minds, warping the already monstrous experiments, and tearing open rifts to unknown dimensions.

Combine your skills with relics to explore deeper into the CCA compound. Walk or Stand your ground to concentrate your firepower or Run to evade and blaze a trail. Hack the Kerberos security system to access locked blast doors. Find your way through wind tunnels. Evade or aggravate psionic breaches. Use your paranormal relics to access prohibited parts of the facility.

You were an ordinary CCA personnel, seemingly drawn to the epicenter of the disaster... until the breach awakened something deep within you. A power that feels ancient, familiar... like a half-remembered life cut tragically short.

Now, you wield strange abilities – some erupting from within, echoes of forgotten figures wronged by fate or gods, others channeled through mundane objects twisted into powerful 'conduits' and 'vessels' by the anomalous energy saturating the CCA.

Navigate the corridors, compromised labs, and unsettling containment zones of the CCA facility. Defeat overwhelming waves of possessed scientists, corrupted security forces, paranormal entities and abominations born from twisted experiments unleashed in the chaos. Encounter unique bosses.

Collect residual life essence to grow your powers. Craft unique builds combining raw psychic phenomena, paranormal CCA artifacts, and experimental tech.

Combine your skills with relics to explore deeper into the CCA compound. Hack the Kerberos security system to access locked blast doors. Find your way through wind tunnels. Evade or aggravate psionic breaches. 

Can you handle the escalating chaos? Can you survive long enough to discover what is truly behind the CCA's fall? Can you fully reawaken the legend within and exalt the strange artifacts calling to you?

How many re-lives are you willing to endure?

Key Features:

  • Intense Bullet Heaven Survival: Focus on masterful movement and strategic positioning as your abilities automatically decimate waves of enemies.

  • Walk or Stand your ground to concentrate your firepower or Run to evade and blaze

  • Your life is never over, thanks to the Charon Protocol. Re-life and jump into action with any of the characters you unlock.

  • The horde gets numerous and stronger, the longer you survive. They are drawn to your untainted consciousness.

  • Wield Awakened & Channeled Power: Unleash innate abilities alongside potent effects channeled through mysterious conduits and vessels found within the anomalous zones.

  • Atmospheric Dread: Explore the eerie, reality-bending environments of a high-tech facility consumed by paranormal corruption and technological failure.

  • Confront the Corrupted: Battle hordes of enemies manipulated by an unknown source; from mind-dead researchers and guards to paranormal entities and experimental subjects.

  • Echoes of Forgotten Myths: Discover other individuals mysteriously empowered, each embodying obscure legends and figures cheated by destiny. Unravel their stories alongside the CCA's dark secrets. Is this journey for survival, self-discovery, revenge, or redemption?

  • Uncover the Source: Piece together the truth behind the CCA breach through scattered logs, clues, and cryptic messages hinting at a deeper, hidden intelligence.

  • Synergistic Builds: Discover countless upgrades for both inherent powers and item-based abilities. Combine powers and evolve your arsenal

  • Meta-Progression: Grow stronger between runs by unlocking permanent enhancements, new abilities, potent starting conduits, and more characters seeking to rewrite their ending.

The walls between worlds are thin. Awaken the legend. Survive the chaos. Uncover the secrets.

Wishlist Now!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / Nvidia GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 (Mesa 22.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 570 (Mesa 22.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Unleash your paranormal weapons on the hordes, Exalt your arsenal and earn permanent upgrades to awaken the myths they were meant to be...one life at a time
